progression_rules.hip: Clinician/PT clearance required for ballistic KB hinge and complex hip loading. Stop provoking movements for sharp pain, catching, limp or next-day flare; use explicit non-ballistic fallback.
progression_rules.volume: Primary A/B exercises 3 sets except Week 6, Week 10, and Wed Week 12 (2 for fatigue management); all C/D/E/F/K accessories 2 sets; power sets are short, quality-based, and may serve as a 3-set primary.
progression_rules.autoregulation: Reps first until all prescribed sets meet upper rep boundary with >=2 RIR and pain-free technique. Then increase external resistance by smallest feasible increment. Do not increase load and reps concurrently.
progression_rules.power: Explosive push-ups/claps and MB throws early in tri-set; cease a set at velocity or landing-quality drop, never grind or train power to failure.
progression_rules.KB: Mon/Wed progressive dynamic KB subject to hip clearance; Friday low-RPE KB stability/skill only. Friday should leave legs fresh for Sat hills; no swings/cleans Friday.
progression_rules.HIIT: Tue and Thu: real RPE 8–9 work bouts, with active easy recoveries and controlled total hard-work time. Deload cuts rounds, not both sessions. No KB on HIIT days.
progression_rules.cycling: Tue+Thu HIIT on Echo count as >30 minute bike exposures. Fri separate 32–35 minute easy cycling. Sat long outdoor riding with elevation accounted. Do not add extra 30–45 minutes after a complete full-strength Mon/Wed session.
progression_rules.fatigue: Daily effort and next morning hip response govern substitutions. Inability to recover after two HIIT+two strength sessions: first reduce Thu accessory load/Friday KB, not eliminate HIIT.
progression_rules.week_13: Dedicated assessment follows twelve training weeks. Standardize pull-up/dip testing, age- and hip-appropriate lower-body measures, technical KB performance, archery steadiness, Echo and terrain-adjusted cycling.
progression_rules.week_3_timing: Measure block elapsed time; 30-set strength days remain time-sensitive. If time overruns, reorganize transitions and spread lower-priority accessory work rather than shortening necessary strength recovery or claiming completion.

pull_neutral.name: Strict neutral-grip pull-up
pull_neutral.cue: Dead hang to chin over bar; no kip; control lower 2 s.
pull_neutral.starting_load: Bodyweight; Week 1 7-rep sets, Week 2 3–4 reps on tired days

pull_pronated.name: Strict pronated pull-up
pull_pronated.cue: Hands slightly outside shoulders, chin over bar without reaching; smooth descent.
pull_pronated.starting_load: Bodyweight; begin with sets 3–5 rather than assume neutral-grip capacity

pull_weight.name: Weighted neutral-grip pull-up
pull_weight.cue: Hold ribs down; full pain-free ROM; end set before loss of scapular control.

pull_pause.name: Top-paused strict pull-up
pull_pause.cue: Hold 1 s chin over bar with shoulders active; 2–3 s lower; no kicking.

pull_ecc.name: Eccentric pull-up
pull_ecc.cue: Use safe box to top, lower smoothly 4 s; step down rather than jumping.
pull_ecc.starting_load: Bodyweight or light band assistance; no failure reps

pull_cluster.name: Strict pull-up cluster
pull_cluster.cue: Perform short crisp clusters; 20–30 s between mini-sets, stop with 2 reps left.

dip_weight.name: Weighted parallel-bar dip
dip_weight.cue: Shoulders packed; dip to controlled comfortable depth; no bounce.
dip_weight.starting_load: Start +26–35 lb; Week 2 +35 ×5; use RIR target

dip_body.name: Strict bodyweight dip
dip_body.cue: Shoulder-safe depth, fully controlled ascent; no shrug or bounce.

dip_pause.name: Paused dip
dip_pause.cue: Hold 1 s at comfortable bottom depth, then strong controlled press.
dip_pause.starting_load: Bodyweight or +0–15 lb only if fully pain-free

dip_ecc.name: Tempo dip (3 s down)
dip_ecc.cue: Three-second eccentric without sinking into shoulder; press smoothly.

dip_volume.name: Dip repetition ladder
dip_volume.cue: Accumulate controlled submaximal reps with 1–2 reps reserved in each set.
dip_volume.starting_load: Bodyweight; do not train to failure

push_weight.name: Band-resisted push-up
push_weight.cue: Anchor band securely; plank rigid and full comfortable ROM.
push_weight.starting_load: Light–medium band; Week 2: 15–25 recorded band/load units

push_stagger.name: Staggered-hand push-up
push_stagger.cue: Offset hands by a palm width, alternate lead each set; hips square.
push_stagger.starting_load: Bodyweight; 4–6 per hand position per set

push_handrelease.name: Hand-release push-up
push_handrelease.cue: Chest comes gently to floor, hands briefly release, press fast from dead stop.

push_expl_incline.name: Explosive incline push-up
push_expl_incline.cue: Press fast enough hands unload slightly; land quietly with soft elbows.
push_expl_incline.starting_load: Bench height chosen for crisp reps; 3–5 fast reps
push_expl_incline.fallback: Fast concentric incline push-up without flight

push_plyo_floor.name: Plyometric floor push-up
push_plyo_floor.cue: Explode from stable plank; hands leave floor briefly; quiet controlled landing.
push_plyo_floor.starting_load: Bodyweight only; omit if wrists/shoulders not tolerant

push_clap.name: Clapping push-up
push_clap.cue: Explode and clap once only if adequate height; land softly, elbows track.
push_clap.starting_load: Bodyweight; 2–4 quality reps, never to failure

med_chest.name: Kneeling or standing medicine-ball chest pass
med_chest.cue: Explode forward to a safe wall/partner; retrieve with full reset; no hip rotation.
med_chest.starting_load: 20-lb ball; standing only if hip stable; if too heavy use fast incline push-up

bench_flat.name: Flat dumbbell bench press
bench_flat.cue: Controlled 2 s lower, shoulder blades stabilized, decisive press.

bench_incline.name: Incline neutral-grip DB press
bench_incline.cue: Bench moderate incline, neutral grip, ribs down.

bench_floor.name: DB floor press with 1 s pause
bench_floor.cue: Upper arms rest lightly on floor; pause and press without bounce.

bench_unilat.name: Single-arm DB bench press
bench_unilat.cue: Use a stable bench, square pelvis, press without rolling torso.
bench_unilat.starting_load: 25–40 lb per side; controlled rotation resistance

press_seated.name: Seated neutral-grip DB overhead press
press_seated.cue: Press through pain-free arc, avoid lumbar flare.

press_kb_single.name: Seated single-arm KB strict press
press_kb_single.cue: KB rests in front rack; vertical smooth press, torso tall.

row_1arm.name: Bench-supported one-arm DB row
row_1arm.cue: Hand and knee/forearm supported; square hips, no torso heave.

row_chest.name: Chest-supported DB row
row_chest.cue: Upper chest stays on inclined bench; pause at top.

row_elbow.name: Chest-supported wide-elbow DB row
row_elbow.cue: Pull elbows 45–65 degrees from sides; squeeze upper back, no shrug.
row_elbow.starting_load: 15–30 lb each; lighter than standard row

row_2sec.name: One-arm DB row with 2 s top pause
row_2sec.cue: Support torso; freeze dumbbell near ribs without twisting.
row_2sec.starting_load: 35–52.5 lb; choose load that allows pause

row_bandfast.name: Explosive band row
row_bandfast.cue: Pull powerfully toward lower ribs, controlled return; no spinal rocking.
row_bandfast.starting_load: Light band; tension permits fast smooth action

box_goblet.name: 14-inch goblet box squat
box_goblet.cue: Light contact on box, stand without rocking; hip-comfortable depth.
box_goblet.starting_load: 44–53 lb KB baseline 53 ×7; do not force greater depth

box_double.name: 14-inch double-DB suitcase box squat
box_double.cue: DBs at sides; controlled 2 s lower and drive up smoothly.

box_pause.name: 14-inch box squat with 2 s pause
box_pause.cue: Remain braced briefly on box, do not fully relax or rock; stand controlled.
box_pause.starting_load: 25–44 lb KB or 2 DB; decrease load for pause

box_offset.name: 14-inch offset-loaded box squat
box_offset.cue: Hold single KB in rack, no trunk lean, alternate rack side each set.
box_offset.starting_load: 5–25 lb KB, choose easy stable load

step_low.name: Supported low step-up (14-inch or lower)
step_low.cue: Use stable hand support; step only to height that produces no hip pinch; slow return.
step_low.starting_load: Bodyweight or 7.5–20 lb DB; lower step if 14-inch painful

sitstand_fast.name: Fast concentric box sit-to-stand
sitstand_fast.cue: Slow down to box, drive up quickly without jumping; stop when speed falls.
sitstand_fast.starting_load: Bodyweight or 5–25 lb held load; pain-free only

hinge_db.name: Two-DB Romanian deadlift
hinge_db.cue: Soft knees, brace and hinge only within comfortable range; stand tall.

hinge_pause.name: Paused DB Romanian deadlift
hinge_pause.cue: Brief 1 s pause at mid-shin/comfortable hinge depth, then stand.
hinge_pause.starting_load: 2×30–45 lb; avoid depth that pinches hip

hinge_kick.name: Supported kickstand DB hinge
hinge_kick.cue: Rear toe for balance; front leg loads, pelvis level; controlled small range.
hinge_kick.starting_load: One DB 20–35 lb; Week 2 supported hinge 26 lb ×8

hinge_elev.name: Elevated DB deadlift
hinge_elev.cue: Set DBs on blocks to raise handles; brace then stand without rounding.
hinge_elev.starting_load: 2×35–52.5 lb; raise starting height as needed

bridge.name: Glute bridge with 2 s top hold
bridge.cue: Feet planted, extend only to comfortable neutral hip, no back arch.
bridge.starting_load: Bodyweight to DB across hips only if comfortable

sandbag_carry.name: Sandbag bear-hug carry
sandbag_carry.cue: Hug bag, short stable strides, maintain tall posture; do not provoke limp.
sandbag_carry.starting_load: 62.5 lb only if hip comfortable; otherwise lighter DB carry

kb_swing2.name: Two-hand hardstyle KB swing
kb_swing2.cue: Hinge, snap hips to stand, let bell float; no squat or lumbar swing.
kb_swing2.starting_load: Start 25–44 lb; 53 ×8 logged, not a technique clearance

kb_swing1.name: One-arm KB swing
kb_swing1.cue: Hinge and project bell forward; prevent trunk rotation; change hands after set.
kb_swing1.starting_load: 25 lb initially; only with clearance and flawless two-hand swing

kb_clean.name: Single-arm KB clean to front rack
kb_clean.cue: Pull bell close, soft forearm catch, no twisting or hip pinch.

kb_cleanpress.name: Single-arm KB clean + strict press
kb_cleanpress.cue: Clean to rack, pause and press without back extension; controlled return.
kb_cleanpress.starting_load: 25 lb maximum initially; only after clean and press independent skills
kb_cleanpress.fallback: KB rack hold + seated DB press

kb_highpull.name: KB high-pull skill
kb_highpull.cue: Drive via hinge and pull bell toward chest without flipping; elbow under control.
kb_highpull.starting_load: 5–25 lb; must be taught/competent; no painful hip action

kb_snatch.name: KB snatch skill, single arm
kb_snatch.cue: Hinge-driven path, punch through to quiet overhead lockout; descend safely.
kb_snatch.starting_load: 5–25 lb; only if clearance and coached technique

kb_dead.name: KB deadlift from elevated support
kb_dead.cue: Bell centered, spine neutral, use blocks to limit hip depth.

kb_gorilla.name: Supported alternating KB gorilla-style row
kb_gorilla.cue: Hinge only to tolerable angle and support spare hand on bench; row KB then switch.
kb_gorilla.starting_load: 25–44 lb single KB; support prevents deep hip hinge

kb_row.name: Bench-supported one-arm KB row
kb_row.cue: Opposite arm supported on bench; pull bell to hip without twisting.

kb_frontcarry.name: Single-arm KB front-rack carry
kb_frontcarry.cue: Bell in secure rack, ribs stacked, walk level; switch sides.

kb_suitcarry.name: KB suitcase carry
kb_suitcarry.cue: Bell at side, shoulders level, slow stable gait, no lean.

kb_waiter.name: Single-arm KB overhead hold or short waiter carry
kb_waiter.cue: Elbow stable, ribs down, no shoulder shrug; start stationary.
kb_waiter.starting_load: 5–25 lb only if shoulder stable and comfortable

kb_halo.name: KB halo
kb_halo.cue: Move bell slowly around head, trunk still; maintain pain-free shoulder ROM.
kb_halo.starting_load: 5 lb or 25 lb only if appropriate; no intermediate KB available

kb_fig8.name: KB figure-eight transfer, shallow hinge
kb_fig8.cue: Pass bell between legs using shallow comfortable hinge; torso stable.
kb_fig8.starting_load: 5–25 lb only if hip-friendly; no twisting through joint

kb_transfer.name: KB standing hand-to-hand rack transfer
kb_transfer.cue: Shift bell between hands at chest height while maintaining static pelvis.

kb_floor.name: Single-arm KB floor press
kb_floor.cue: Pause arm on floor, press vertically without trunk twist.

kb_rowplank.name: Supported plank + KB drag (light)
kb_rowplank.cue: Hands on elevated bench, drag KB carefully across midline without hip twist.
kb_rowplank.starting_load: 5 lb KB or substitute band; no loaded spinal rotation

kb_march.name: KB front-rack stationary march
kb_march.cue: Stay tall; small alternating foot lifts, pelvis level.

kb_complex.name: KB clean–rack hold–press complex
kb_complex.cue: One deliberate clean, 2 s rack hold, one strict press = 1 rep; reset.
kb_complex.starting_load: 25 lb, technical only; no HIIT effort

carry_db.name: Two-DB farmer carry or stationary hold
carry_db.cue: Maintain tall posture, level pelvis and grip; short strides or static hold.

facepull.name: Band face pull
facepull.cue: Pull band to eyes, open hands and externally rotate smoothly.

external.name: Side-lying DB external rotation
external.cue: Upper arm stable, rotate within safe shoulder arc.

curl_hammer.name: DB hammer curl
curl_hammer.cue: Thumbs-up grip, elbows close; avoid swinging torso.

curl_supine.name: Supinating DB curl
curl_supine.cue: Start neutral and rotate palm up during curl without elbow drift.

extension.name: Overhead single-DB triceps extension
extension.cue: Elbows point up, ribs down, use gentle shoulder range.

lateral.name: DB lateral raise
lateral.cue: Slight elbow bend, raise in scapular plane without torso momentum.

reverse.name: Incline DB reverse fly
reverse.cue: Chest supported, slow shoulder-driven outward lift.

Yraise.name: Incline prone Y raise
Yraise.cue: Thumbs up, small pain-free lift with shoulder blades controlled.

pallof.name: Band Pallof press and hold
pallof.cue: Press hands forward, resist rotation, quiet pelvis and steady breathing.

deadbug.name: Dead bug alternating reach
deadbug.cue: Opposite arm/leg extend without lumbar arch or hip pinch.

sideplank.name: Side plank with top-arm reach
sideplank.cue: Lift hips and hold neutral trunk; reach only if shoulder stable.

plank_row.name: Bench-supported contralateral plank DB row
plank_row.cue: Hand on bench, feet wide, row opposite hand without pelvic turning.

archery_draw.name: Bilateral band draw-to-anchor with hold
archery_draw.cue: Draw to consistent anchor, pause 3–5 s, steady shoulder; both sides.
archery_draw.starting_load: Light band; document hold time and steadiness

archery_hold.name: Isometric band draw hold
archery_hold.cue: Draw to fixed anchor and hold 20–40 s without drifting; train both sides.

scap_wall.name: Wall slide with lift-off
scap_wall.cue: Forearms slide up wall; gently lift without shrug or lumbar arch.

grip_hold.name: Timed DB farmer hold
grip_hold.cue: Heavy DBs at sides, posture upright, measure controlled time.

calf.name: Standing DB calf raise
calf.cue: Slow controlled ankle excursion and 1 s top pause.

assessments.title: Pull-up endurance + weighted pull reference
assessments.work: 10-min warm-up; strict neutral-grip maximal technically valid reps (same ROM/grip as baseline), rest 6–8 min; weighted +10 lb pull-up submaximal comparison 2×3–5 with RIR recorded; bilateral shoulder draw hold 2× per side; finish easy bike 10 min.

assessments.title: Echo reproducibility and aerobic benchmark
assessments.work: 10-min easy warm-up, then standardized 6×(30 s hard / 90 s easy) on Echo at matched device resistance and identical setup; capture each-round calories/watts if available, total calories, distance, HR, perceived recovery, and full session time. Cool down 8 min. No KB.

assessments.title: Dip endurance + weighted dip reference
assessments.work: 10-min warm-up; strict unweighted dip max with matched safe depth and no shoulder bounce; rest 6–8 min; +35 lb weighted dip comparison 2×4–6, record RIR; technique-consistent press test 52.5 lb DB if tolerated (one submaximal set); easy recovery only.

assessments.title: Hip-tolerated lower-body + functional KB
assessments.work: After warm-up, compare 14-inch box squat at 53 lb with matched ROM and RIR, 2×6–10; DB RDL at matched load 2×8; technique-scored two-hand KB swing 2×10 only if hip cleared; KB carry controlled duration 2×/side; no maximal painful attempts.

assessments.title: Body composition, grip and archery stability
assessments.work: Morning average bodyweight (use 7-day mean), waist/chest/upper-arm/thigh under repeatable conditions; timed DB farmer hold at matched load, 2 trials; bilateral draw-to-anchor isometric holds 2 trials each, document deviation and shoulder symptoms; relaxed mobility.

assessments.title: Comparable outdoor ride
assessments.work: Repeat a known ride or choose closely matched elevation, surface and duration; record elapsed/moving time, distance, total ascent, HR/zone confidence, RPE and next-day hip response. Avoid turning this into a dangerous time trial.

assessments.title: Recovery + 12-week outcome review
assessments.work: No training test. Consolidate Week 1 baseline, Weeks 2–12 activity, Week 13 assessment; calculate changes and next-cycle priorities. Report missing data instead of inferring it.
